rows.grounds: locative of direction indicating the northeastern quarter
optative prescribing the construction of the figure

items.question: What alternative shapes may be arranged in the northeastern quarter?
premises: The northeastern quarter is specified as the location for arrangement.
A square figure is presented as an admissible option.
A round figure is presented as an alternative admissible option.
items.inference: Therefore one may arrange either a square or a round figure in the northeastern quarter.
items.plain_english: In the northeastern quarter, one should arrange either a square or a round figure.
